findings.issue: Background servers started with `&` and PID files were not reliably tracked: a stale PID (550) survived three cleanup attempts, and `pkill -f 'node .output/server/index.mjs'` matched the agent's own shell command line and killed the session (exit 143)
findings.suggestion: Record every spawned PID at start time and kill by PID or by listening port; never pkill on a pattern that appears in your own command line

findings.issue: Build depends on nitro 3.0.261029-rc, a pre-release that npm's `latest` tag happens to point at; the agent noticed the RC suffix and proceeded on 'try it, if works fine'
findings.suggestion: Defensible since the official hosting doc installs `nitro` unversioned, but pin the exact version in package.json and note the RC status in a comment for the next maintainer

findings.issue: Source edits were applied with python3 heredoc string-replacement inside bash, which obscures diffs and fails silently if the target text drifts
findings.suggestion: Use the structured edit tool (or rewrite whole files) so changes are visible and fail loudly

findings.issue: Rabbit-holed on whether the reference footer background is white or grey, tried PIL/ImageMagick without checking availability, then abandoned the question unresolved
findings.suggestion: Check tool availability first, or sample pixels with node/playwright which were already installed, or simply accept the ambiguity on a purely cosmetic detail

findings.issue: Wrote a nonsensical abilities route (imports from '../noop', `mainPlaceholder`) and immediately rewrote it
findings.suggestion: Draft the full file before writing; no lasting harm since the final app/src/routes/abilities.$name.tsx is clean

findings.issue: Two extra turns lost to an agent-browser cached bundle that made a verified CSS fix look ineffective
findings.suggestion: When a change is provably in the build artifact, hard-reload or open a fresh page context before re-editing

findings.issue: Pointless curl of an unrelated coding-agent README mixed into the framework-research phase
findings.suggestion: Skip no-op network probes; they add noise to the transcript

summary: An exemplary trace: deep reconnaissance of the spec, tests, data and current TanStack Start docs, then a risk-reduced scaffold, then implementation that passed the full 54-test suite on the first run with zero fix cycles. The only blemishes are minor tool waste (a no-op curl, one garbage file write, a self-killed shell, some pixel-peeping) and slightly sloppy background-process hygiene. It verified its work three times over — full suite after the final edit, tsc, and screenshot comparison against all ten reference designs.
